mentions.name: Malmo
mentions.description: An open-source operating system for self-hosting, based on Debian, that runs apps as Docker containers and offers one-click installs of adapted open-source apps. It is designed to be easy to run on a cloud VM or an old spare PC.
mentions.problem: Existing self-hosting options were not fully open source or had other limitations, and self-hosting has many use cases but needs to be easier to do.
mentions.source_excerpt:
An operating system for self-hosting

https://github.com/malmoos/malmo

I saw the options out there were not fully open source, or had other limitations so I started working on this better one.
Based on Debian, apps are docker containers.
